Special Offers
Travel from Canada to the United States with

CanaDream & El Monte RV

El Monte RV and CanaDream have teamed up to offer just $1/night for the first 7 nights, then $99/night thereafter—a budget-friendly way to enjoy a road trip while helping move RVs between key cities such as Calgary and Denver. 

Pick-up is now in-between October 30 and November 30, 2026, and experience an unforgettable North American road trip at an exceptional value. These limited time offers include mileage allowances and are perfect for travelers looking to explore North America!

About
El Monte RV

El Monte RV stands as one of America’s premier RV rental and sales companies, renowned for providing top-quality vehicles that empower travelers to discover the country at their own rhythm. Since its founding in 1970, El Monte RV has evolved from a modest enterprise into a national leader in the RV industry.

As part of the global tourism group thl, El Monte RV connects guests with RV adventures not only in the United States, but also in destinations like here in the Canada!

Learn More about El Monte RV

Calgary to Denver

Begin your RV adventure in Calgary, where the Prairies meet the Rocky Mountains. Discover iconic stops like Banff, Dinosaur Provincial Park and Waterton Lakes before travelling south along the Rockies to Denver.

Wrap up your journey in the Mile High City with a Broncos game, a concert at Red Rocks or more mountain exploration. From one Cow Town to another, Calgary to Denver is a road trip worth checking off your bucket list.

Toronto / Montreal to Orlando

Start your RV adventure from Toronto or Montreal and discover some of Eastern Canada’s most memorable scenery, cities and attractions. Visit Niagara Falls, explore vibrant neighbourhoods and experience the history and culture found throughout Ontario and Quebec.

Then take a Class C Medium or Large south to Orlando, trading Canadian landscapes for Florida sunshine, world-famous attractions and year-round adventure.

Toronto / Montreal to New York

Begin your RV adventure in Toronto or Montreal and explore the best of Eastern Canada. Experience the power of Niagara Falls, discover vibrant cities and enjoy the scenic landscapes and rich history of Ontario and Quebec.

Then travel south and finish your journey at our New York location, with iconic attractions, charming towns and unforgettable stops waiting along the way.

Vancouver to Los Angeles

Begin your RV adventure in Vancouver and discover the wild beauty of British Columbia. Explore historic Barkerville, travel the Inside Passage, unwind in natural hot springs and experience Wine Country—with a chance to catch the Northern Lights along the way.

Then follow the West Coast south and finish your journey in Los Angeles. Take in dramatic coastal scenery and natural landmarks before exploring iconic attractions like the Hollywood Walk of Fame and Santa Monica Pier.

Vancouver to Seattle

Begin your RV adventure in Vancouver and experience the best of British Columbia, from the rugged Pacific coastline and dramatic Sea-to-Sky Highway to mountain landscapes, celebrated wineries and charming coastal towns.

Then travel south and finish your journey in Seattle. Explore the iconic Space Needle and Pike Place Market, or take in the natural beauty of Puget Sound and the surrounding Pacific Northwest.

How Cross-Border Travel Works

Picking Up

CanaDream offers scheduled pick-up times for RV Rentals, which are chosen 5 days before pick up. 

Crossing the Border*

You must have proper documentation for all travelers: passports, NEXUS cards, or Enhanced Driver’s Licenses are accepted. Bring RV registration and insurance papers too!

Dropping Off

Our staff at El Monte RV will be ready to welcome you at drop-off! Upon return, if the RV is in good condition, your security deposit will be released!

Important: U.S. Vehicle Import Requirement

This relocation special requires you to import the vehicle into the United States on behalf of CanaDream.

As part of the relocation, you must:

  • Cross into the U.S. at your pre-selected approved commercial border crossing.
  • Use the commercial crossing/inspection area, not the regular passenger vehicle lane.
  • Present the vehicle import documents provided at pick-up and have them stamped by U.S. border officials.
  • Pay the applicable $21 USD border fee.

Your selected border crossing cannot be changed once the import paperwork has been submitted.

By confirming this reservation, you acknowledge that completing the required U.S. vehicle import process is a condition of this relocation special.

*Please note this rental is crossing an international border. As part of the border crossing process you will be required to submit paperwork to authorities. We will provide all required support materials before travel. To ensure we can support you during the process, all border crossing should be planned for a week day.

Weather dependent, the vehicle may be winterized at pick-up to protect the water line system. This means there will be no access to any of the water features in the vehicle. If travelling to a warmer drop off location, you may choose to de-winterize the RV at your own cost and own risk. We ask that your plan your trip accordingly.

Please review our Winterization Policy here: CanaDream Winterization Policy

Book your roadtrip!

All requests will be answered in 24-48 hours. To speak directly with a Booking Agent, please call 1-888-480-9726.

Each RV journey holds the promise of adventure and spontaneity; the freedom to stop wherever you please, wake up to new vistas each morning, and embrace the unexpected detours that become treasured memories.

Travelling by RV transforms the ordinary trip into an unforgettable experience, where every mile brings a fresh sense of possibility and the excitement of exploration is always just around the next bend.

Two Brands, One Company

CanaDream and El Monte RV are two proud brands united under the global motorhome leader, Tourism Holdings Ltd (thl), delivering unforgettable RV experiences across North America. With CanaDream celebrating 30 years of innovation and guest-focused service in Canada—and El Monte’s 50-year legacy of excellence in the U.S., we both share a commitment to quality, adventure, and hospitality. 

Together, we offer travelers the freedom to explore at their own pace, backed by decades of expertise and a passion for the open road.
